## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: DeepWeeds classification: 94.72% with 9.46M trainable parameters, against 92.23% for full fine-tuning with 85.81M. CropAndWeed detection: 66.23 mAP50 with 27.11M parameters, against 63.25 with 103.46M. The paper does not measure forgetting.
US [weeds]: The best available evidence that the professor's freeze-plus-adapter (LoRA-style) idea can match or beat full fine-tuning on weed tasks with about 9x fewer trainable parameters. Adapters also make rollback cheap: an increment's adapter can be discarded without touching the base. Forgetting is untested, so our loop would have to measure it on the cwd12 holdout itself.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: AdaptFormer adapters; pixel or frozen-DINOv3 feature targets; DeepWeeds 94.72% (9.46M) vs 92.23% full fine-tuning (85.81M); CropAndWeed mAP50 66.23 (27.11M) vs 63.25 (103.46M); forgetting is not measured. The quoted figures are for the DINOv3 feature-reconstruction variant.
